facts.text: One&Only Royal Mirage is a beachfront resort in the heart of Dubai.
facts.excerpt: In the heart of Dubai, beachfront One&Only Royal Mirage evokes timeless Arabian elegance and vibrant energy

facts.text: The resort has a kilometre of private beach.
facts.excerpt: Boasting a kilometre of pristine private beach

facts.text: The resort is set in lush gardens along Jumeirah Beach.
facts.excerpt: the resort is set in an oasis of lush gardens along Jumeirah Beach

facts.text: The resort overlooks Palm Jumeirah island and is near Dubai Marina.
facts.excerpt: overlooking tree-shaped Palm Jumeirah island near Dubai Marina
offering palm-lined pools, exceptional dining and fun for all ages

facts.text: The resort blends classic Arabian architecture with modern energy.
facts.excerpt: One&Only Royal Mirage blends classic Arabian architecture with modern energy

facts.text: The resort is backdropped by Dubai's skyline.
facts.excerpt: a coastal resort backdropped by Dubai's glittering skyline

facts.text: Dubai International Airport is about a 30-minute drive from the resort.
The resort can arrange private luxury transfers from Dubai International Airport or Abu Dhabi International Airport.
facts.excerpt: Let us arrange private luxury transfers from Dubai International Airport

facts.text: The resort holds EarthCheck Silver status for its sustainable practices.
facts.excerpt: With an EarthCheck Silver status, our resort implements sustainable practices and action plans

facts.text: In 2025 the resort was awarded Best Hammam in Dubai in the FACT Spa & Wellness Awards.
facts.excerpt: In 2025, our resort was awarded Best Hammam in Dubai in the FACT Spa & Wellness Awards

facts.text: Elite Traveller praised the resort's suites.
The resort can assist guests with a Dubai visa application.
facts.excerpt: One&Only Royal Mirage can assist with the relevant visa application

facts.text: Complimentary basic WiFi is available in rooms and around most of the outdoor pool facilities, with high-speed WiFi for a fee.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy complimentary 512kbps WiFi/email browsing access for up to two devices in the comfort of your room and around most of the outdoor pool facilities.

facts.text: The resort offers fun for all ages.
Guests should dress and behave appropriately in respect of the local culture on excursions or in shopping malls.
facts.excerpt: Please dress and behave appropriately in respect of the local culture.
